question: Where’s the closest museum as you go toward Arsenal Contemporary Art, New York, NY from Children's Hospital at Montefiore, Bronx, NY?
sql: WITH origin AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Children''s Hospital at Montefiore%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Bronx%' LIMIT 1 ), destination AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Arsenal Contemporary Art%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%New York%' LIMIT 1 ), path_line AS ( SELECT ST_MakeLine(o.geometry, d.geometry) AS geom FROM origin AS o, destination AS d ), path_buffer AS ( SELECT ST_Buffer(geom::geography, 500) AS geom -- Create a 500-meter buffer around the direct path FROM path_line ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_state, p.addr_city FROM pois AS p, origin AS o, destination AS d, path_buffer AS pb WHERE p.tourism = 'museum' -- Filter for museums AND ST_Intersects(p.geometry::geography, pb.geom::geography) -- Museum is within the path buffer AND ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, d.geometry::geography) < ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, o.geometry::geography) -- Museum is closer to the destination than the origin (i.e., "on the way") ORDER BY ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, o.geometry::geography) ASC -- Order by distance from the origin to find the closest one LIMIT 1;
